content: Of the 739 sentences, the participants read 349 sentences in a normal reading paradigm, and 390 sentences in a task-specific reading paradigm, in which they had to determine whether a certain relation type occurred in the sentence or not. Table TABREF3 shows the distribution of the different relation types in the sentences of the task-specific annotation paradigm.
